RULED 2026-09-18 (round 16, item 2): read 2 FAIL, STOPPED under Rule 7 (gate-log 80, 86) -- the architect reduces the README to the facts read 2 verified clean and the spike lands with the reduced record by a PR for the click; done on merge. What G1 established (entry 111): a u64 rows-processed reading exists on the read_parquet path and is fine-grained; the engine cannot reach it through the vendored Connection; the count must be latched engine-side; DuckDB reports an estimated denominator. The route: deferred to Brief B B2 (round 16, item 3; node decision-adr-029-scan-progress-route). Earlier: RULED 2026-09-14 (question set C, C2): G1, first and blocking -- verify against the vendored duckdb crate that a monotone scan-progress reading in whole declared units exists; if none does, the quantity question RETURNS to the human rather than shipping a non-monotone one. Cargo-heavy; machine-sequenced after the sitting (one heavy run at a time). Its result returns to ADR-029 and, if it bounces, to the human
